_readme: S741 lane 1 (keys): Solano Community College's four records S740 left held on the own-page guard, read from the 2026-27 catalog PDF, line for line, free, no model call, nothing written: Mechatronics A.S. 30184 and its certificate 30185 (one section printed for both awards: how does the section word each award, and what do its printed units add to against 'Required Major Total Units 37'?), World Languages A.A. 43134 (the state's file lists the program twice, 06538 and 43134) and American Sign Language A.A. 38591 (its section, and the ASL/English Interpreter Training section its note says the state's list matches). It also prints the course description of ADVM 051, which the Mechatronics list prints as ADVM 151.
